'''The Orchid''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] located in [[Drepplin]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Glova]]. The Orchid was the only hotel in the city, and thus attracted a wide ranging clientele. The service was excellent, and for those with good contacts in the government, fares were as low as 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per night but the average citizen would have to pay 75-100 credits per night.

The Orchid was attached to a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Aramand's]]. The complex was owned and operated by Glova's [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Tegist Byrg]].
